description:
Welcome to our hackathon team! We turn big ideas into fun, working projects, from space-health dashboards to games that teach kids about life on the Moon and Mars.
Here is Astrata We love:
🎮 Games that are fun and teach something
💻 Software that solves real problems
⌨️ Coding, whether you're a pro or just starting
🌐 Web development for sites anyone can open and use
🎨 Graphic design that makes everything look great
Come learn, build, and create something awesome with us!
